# sendgrid_ip_address (Resource)

Adds a dedicated IP address to the account via the IP Address Management API (`/v3/send_ips/ips`), distinct from `sendgrid_ip_pool` (which manages pool membership only). SendGrid assigns the actual IP address; it cannot be chosen by the caller.

~> Dedicated IPs are billed resources. There is no self-service API to release one — destroying this resource only removes it from Terraform state. Releasing the IP itself requires contacting SendGrid support or adjusting billing.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sendgrid_subuser" "marketing" {
  username = "marketing_subuser"
  email    = "marketing-subuser@example.com"
  password = var.subuser_password
  ips      = ["203.0.113.10"]
}

resource "sendgrid_ip_address" "dedicated" {
  is_auto_warmup     = true
  is_parent_assigned = false
  subusers           = [sendgrid_subuser.marketing.id]
}

variable "subuser_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `is_auto_warmup` (Boolean) Whether the IP address is set to automatically warm up.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the IP address is billed and able to send email. Only applies to non-SendGrid IPs added to the account; always null for SendGrid-leased IPs.
- `is_parent_assigned` (Boolean) Whether a parent account user is able to send email from this IP address.
- `subusers` (Set of String) Numeric Subuser IDs assigned to send from this IP address (the `id` attribute of `sendgrid_subuser`, e.g. `sendgrid_subuser.example.id` — NOT the subuser's username).

### Read-Only

- `added_at` (Number) Unix timestamp indicating when the IP address was added to the account.
- `id` (String) The IP address (identical to `ip`).
- `ip` (String) The dedicated IP address assigned by SendGrid.
- `is_leased` (Boolean) Whether the IP address is leased from Twilio SendGrid, as opposed to a customer-owned IP added to the account.
- `pools` (List of String) Names of the IP pools this IP address currently belongs to. Read-only; manage pool membership via `sendgrid_ip_pool`.
- `updated_at` (Number) Unix timestamp indicating when the IP address was last updated, if ever.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sendgrid_ip_address.dedicated <ip_address>
```
